summary: Frontend-only verification of Phase H Batch 3 uplift (Grading 5 + Utilities 2 + Rigging 2 + Fall Protection 5 = 14 topics). Library integrity validated via Node import (134 EN === 134 ES, 101 with incident_pattern in both languages, 0 EN-has-pattern-but-ES-missing). End-to-end /meetings/new template application verified in EN and ES for one topic from each Batch 3 domain plus an additional Grading topic, with full regression smoke on Batch 1 (Pipe), Batch 2 (Concrete), and Phase C (Trucking) domain chip counts. Severity field confirmed JS-only with zero UI exposure. Mobile 414px: no horizontal overflow.
critical_code_review_comments: All 8 Batch 3 files stay well within the 700-line size guideline (largest is grading.js at 87 lines).
composeIncidentScaffold helper is correctly reused by both applyTemplate (template-load time) and the swapIfPristine path (language-swap detection at submit time) — good DRY discipline.
Severity is consistently present on EN topic objects only (39 EN topics, 0 ES topics carry severity), matching the JS-only/no-UI requirement.

All 14 Batch 3 EN topics have a `severity` value: 12 'fatal_risk' (earthmoving_equipment, backing_spotters, excavator_safety, skid_steer, underground_utilities, overhead_power, cranes_hoisting, rigging_load_securement, fall_protection, aerial_lift, scaffold, bridge_overpass) and 2 'serious_injury' (compaction, ladder_safety).
